inputs.label: Albedo
inputs.coverage: The low-phase PolyCam mosaic is normalized with the ROLO phase function and Lommel–Seeliger disk function. Its 6.25 cm source sampling covers approximately ±55° latitude. The publisher’s 8-bit stretch maps 0.002–0.007 to 1–254. Gray grid marks source NoData, including the polar gaps.

inputs.label: Monochrome
inputs.coverage: The 5 cm global image basemap retains surface texture and photographed shading. It was normalized to 30° phase and registered to the SPC v28 control shape; small differences from the OLA v20 display mesh remain. This is a separate observed image view; it does not silently fill the albedo view’s missing poles.

inputs.label: Spectral color
inputs.coverage: Published MapCam false-color composite over 550 nm normal reflectance. Red shows the 847/550 nm ratio, green the 698 nm band strength, and blue the 473/550 nm ratio. These colors show spectral differences, not natural color or mineral abundance. Coverage extends to about 65° north and south; omitted shadows and gaps use the gray grid. The controlled map is draped on the simplified OLA shape, so individual boulders need not align precisely.
